buffer_analysis.name: Buffer Analysis
buffer_analysis.description: Create fixed-distance buffers around vector features — the most common proximity operation.
buffer_analysis.code:
result = processing.run('native:buffer', {
    'INPUT': layer,
    'DISTANCE': distance,          # map units (meters in projected CRS)
    'SEGMENTS': 8,                 # arc approximation; 8 is default, 16 smoother
    'DISSOLVE': False,             # True = merge overlapping buffers into one
    'OUTPUT': 'memory:buffer'
})
output_layer = result['OUTPUT']

categorized_style.name: Categorized Style
categorized_style.description: Style a vector layer with one symbol per unique value of a field.
categorized_style.code:
from qgis.core import QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer, QgsRendererCategory, QgsSymbol
from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QColor

categories = []
palette = ['#e41a1c', '#377eb8', '#4daf4a', '#984ea3', '#ff7f00']
for i, value in enumerate(layer.uniqueValues(layer.fields().indexOf(field_name))):
    sym = QgsSymbol.defaultSymbol(layer.geometryType())
    sym.setColor(QColor(palette[i % len(palette)]))
    categories.append(QgsRendererCategory(value, sym, str(value)))
layer.setRenderer(QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer(field_name, categories))
layer.triggerRepaint()

clip_layer.name: Clip Layer
clip_layer.description: Extract features of INPUT that fall inside OVERLAY polygons.

dissolve_by_field.name: Dissolve Features by Attribute
dissolve_by_field.description: Merge features that share the same attribute value into one multipart feature — the standard way to aggregate polygons up to a region level.
dissolve_by_field.code:
result = processing.run('native:dissolve', {
    'INPUT': layer,
    'FIELD': ['region'],           # list of field names; [] dissolves everything into one feature
    'SEPARATE_DISJOINT': False,    # True splits non-touching parts back into singleparts
    'OUTPUT': 'memory:dissolved'
})
output_layer = result['OUTPUT']

export_print_layout.name: Export a Print Layout to Image or PDF
export_print_layout.description: Render an existing print layout to PNG or PDF at a chosen DPI — the final step of a map-production workflow.
export_print_layout.code:
from qgis.core import QgsProject, QgsLayoutExporter

manager = QgsProject.instance().layoutManager()
layout = manager.layoutByName('My Layout')   # returns None if the name does not exist

exporter = QgsLayoutExporter(layout)

image_settings = QgsLayoutExporter.ImageExportSettings()
image_settings.dpi = 300
result = exporter.exportToImage('/tmp/map.png', image_settings)

pdf_settings = QgsLayoutExporter.PdfExportSettings()
pdf_settings.dpi = 300
exporter.exportToPdf('/tmp/map.pdf', pdf_settings)

# result == QgsLayoutExporter.Success (0) on success; anything else is a failure code.

field_statistics_report.name: Field Statistics Report
field_statistics_report.description: Full numeric profile of one field: count, min, max, mean, std, median.
field_statistics_report.code:
import statistics
vals = [f[field_name] for f in layer.getFeatures() if f[field_name] is not None]
stats = {
    'count': len(vals),
    'min': min(vals), 'max': max(vals),
    'mean': statistics.fmean(vals),
    'stdev': statistics.stdev(vals) if len(vals) > 1 else 0.0,
    'median': statistics.median(vals),
}

graduated_style.name: Graduated Style
graduated_style.description: Style a numeric field into classes with a color ramp.
graduated_style.code:
from qgis.core import (QgsGraduatedSymbolRenderer, QgsRendererRange,
                       QgsClassificationQuantile, QgsSymbol)
from qgis.PyQt.QtGui import QColor

sym = QgsSymbol.defaultSymbol(layer.geometryType())
renderer = QgsGraduatedSymbolRenderer(
    field_name, [])
renderer.setClassAttribute(field_name)
renderer.setClassificationMethod(QgsClassificationQuantile(5))  # 5 quantile classes
renderer.updateClasses(layer, 5)
ramp = renderer.rasterStylesymbol() if False else None
from qgis.core import QgsGradientColorRamp, QgsGradientStop
renderer.setSourceColorRamp(QgsGradientColorRamp(
    QColor('#fee5d9'), QColor('#99000d')))  # light→dark sequential reds
for rng in renderer.ranges():
    s = QgsSymbol.defaultSymbol(layer.geometryType())
    rng.setSymbol(s)
layer.setRenderer(renderer)
layer.triggerRepaint()

label_layer_basic.name: Label a Layer from a Field
label_layer_basic.description: Turn on labels for a vector layer using one field, with a text buffer for legibility over busy basemaps.
label_layer_basic.code:
from qgis.core import (QgsPalLayerSettings, QgsTextFormat, QgsTextBufferSettings,
                       QgsVectorLayerSimpleLabeling)

buf = QgsTextBufferSettings()
buf.setEnabled(True)
buf.setSize(1.0)

fmt = QgsTextFormat()
fmt.setSize(10)
fmt.setBuffer(buf)

settings = QgsPalLayerSettings()
settings.fieldName = 'name'        # a plain field name, or set isExpression=True for an expression
settings.setFormat(fmt)

layer.setLabeling(QgsVectorLayerSimpleLabeling(settings))
layer.setLabelsEnabled(True)       # BOTH calls are required - labeling alone does not render
layer.triggerRepaint()

reproject_layer.name: Reproject Layer to Another CRS
reproject_layer.description: Reproject a vector layer into a target CRS — required before any distance or area measurement in a geographic (degree-based) CRS.
reproject_layer.code:
result = processing.run('native:reprojectlayer', {
    'INPUT': layer,
    'TARGET_CRS': 'EPSG:3857',     # projected CRS; use a local UTM zone for accurate metres
    'OUTPUT': 'memory:reprojected'
})
output_layer = result['OUTPUT']
# Buffers/areas are only meaningful in a PROJECTED CRS. Reproject first, then measure.

spatial_join_attrs.name: Spatial Join (Attributes)
spatial_join_attrs.description: Transfer summary attributes from JOIN layer onto TARGET features by spatial relationship.
spatial_join_attrs.code:
result = processing.run('native:joinattributesbylocation', {
    'INPUT': target_layer,
    'JOIN': join_layer,
    'PREDICATE': [0],              # 0=intersects 1=contains 2=equals 3=touches 4=overlaps 5=within
    'JOIN_FIELDS': [],             # empty = all fields
    'SUMMARY_ONLY': False,
    'DISCARD_NONMATCHING': False,
    'OUTPUT': 'memory:joined'
})
output_layer = result['OUTPUT']

zonal_statistics_raster.name: Zonal Statistics over a Raster
zonal_statistics_raster.description: Summarise raster values inside each polygon (mean, sum, min, max, count) — the usual join between a raster surface and vector zones.
zonal_statistics_raster.code:
result = processing.run('native:zonalstatisticsfb', {
    'INPUT': polygon_layer,
    'INPUT_RASTER': raster_layer,
    'RASTER_BAND': 1,
    'COLUMN_PREFIX': '_',
    'STATISTICS': [0, 1, 2],       # 0=count 1=sum 2=mean 3=median 4=stdev 5=min 6=max
    'OUTPUT': 'memory:zonalstats'
})
output_layer = result['OUTPUT']
# The polygon layer and the raster must share a CRS, or every zone reads NULL.
